statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) : ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  have h_main : ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n := by
    -- Use the lemma `Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd` to find a prime `p` that divides `n`.
    have h₁ : ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n := by
      -- Apply the lemma `Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd` which states that for any `n > 1`, there exists a prime `p` such that `p ∣ n`.
      apply Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd
      <;> omega
    -- The result follows directly from the lemma.
    exact h₁
  -- The final result is already obtained in `h_main`.
  exact h_main
